the selected weight is supported by the installed command version
required_changes: replace outcome, regressors, weight, FE, and cluster only
tradeoffs: keeps weighted PPML state visible
does not infer whether fweight or pweight is substantively appropriate

requires: declared weight and HDFE cluster structure

template_input_profile.record_unit: one weighted observation with nonnegative outcome

reusable_core: nonnegative outcome에 선언된 weight와 HDFE cluster를 적용한다.
generality_rationale_ko: base PPML-HDFE 및 exposure/offset와 weight state가 달라 별도 원자다.
variant_distinction: [ppmlhdfe_weighted_clustered] weighted PPML-HDFE
review_notes: 후보 단계다. ppmlhdfe weight 지원과 weight semantics를 runtime/audit에서 확인한다.

research_situations: a nonnegative outcome PPML-HDFE model explicitly requires multiple clustering dimensions
selection_conditions: each cluster dimension and absorbed effect is declared
multi-way clustering is a researcher decision
required_changes: replace outcome, regressors, FE, and cluster dimensions only
tradeoffs: keeps multiple clustering dimensions visible
does not interpret an interaction cluster automatically

produces: one active multi-way clustered PPML-HDFE estimate

template_input_profile.record_unit: one observation in multiple PPML-HDFE cluster dimensions
template_input_profile.time_structure: period may be one cluster dimension

reusable_core: ppmlhdfe에 multi-way cluster dimensions를 varlist로 전달한다.
generality_rationale_ko: one-way cluster 및 exposure/offset와 다른 covariance contract다.
variant_distinction: [ppmlhdfe_multiway_cluster] multi-way cluster covariance
review_notes: 후보 단계다. cluster dimensions의 독립성·적합성은 연구자가 정하고 감사에서 확인한다.

research_situations: a declared HDFE model has multiple absorbed fixed-effect dimensions and one-way clustered inference
selection_conditions: outcome, regressors, both absorbed FE dimensions, and one cluster are supplied
the researcher has selected multiple FE with one-way clustering
required_changes: replace outcome, regressors, absorbed FE dimensions, and cluster only
tradeoffs: keeps multiple FE and one cluster dimension separate
does not silently turn one-way clustering into multi-way clustering

requires: two or more declared absorbed FE dimensions
produces: one active multiple-FE clustered HDFE estimate

template_input_profile.record_unit: one observation within multiple declared absorbed FE dimensions
template_input_profile.time_structure: period may be one absorbed FE dimension

reusable_core: 여러 absorbed FE와 단일 cluster를 reghdfe absorb/vce에 분리해 전달한다.
generality_rationale_ko: one-FE cluster, group-level individual FE, multi-way cluster와 각각 FE·row-unit·cluster 차이가 있어 별도 원자다.
variant_distinction: [reghdfe_absorb_multiple_fe_oneway_cluster] multiple absorbed FE dimensions with one-way cluster
review_notes: 후보 단계다. one-way cluster와 multi-way cluster를 자동 변환하지 않으며 감사 전 정식 선택 금지.
